composer.statement: The music for {label} was composed by {value}.
composer.match: Match each musical to its composer.

composer.all: Tap all {n} musicals with music by {value}.

rows.label: Hamilton
rows.description: 2015 musical by Lin-Manuel Miranda about Alexander Hamilton
rows.hook: tells a founding father's life story through hip-hop, rap and R&B songs

rows.label: The Phantom of the Opera
rows.description: musical with music by Andrew Lloyd Webber
rows.hook: centres on a masked, disfigured composer lurking beneath a Paris playhouse and obsessed with a young soprano

rows.label: Les Misérables
rows.description: 1980 musical composed by Claude-Michel Schönberg, libretto by Alain Boublil, lyrics by Alain Boublil and Jean-Marc Natel
rows.hook: follows an ex-convict and a relentless police inspector through the turmoil of 19th-century France

rows.label: Spring Awakening
rows.description: rock musical with music by Duncan Sheik and a book and lyrics by Steven Sater

rows.label: Cabaret
rows.description: theatrical musical by John Kander debuted in 1966
rows.hook: is set in a seedy Berlin nightclub where a painted-faced emcee welcomes everyone in

rows.label: Rent
rows.description: rock musical, loosely based on La Bohème, set in New York during the AIDS Crisis
rows.hook: follows struggling young artists and musicians trying to get by in New York's East Village

rows.label: Chicago
rows.description: 1975 musical by John Kander and Fred Ebb
rows.hook: tells of murderous showgirls and their slick lawyer chasing fame in the Prohibition-era jazz age

rows.label: Jesus Christ Superstar
rows.description: 1971 rock opera by Andrew Lloyd Webber

rows.label: West Side Story
rows.description: American musical with a book by Arthur Laurents, music by Leonard Bernstein and lyrics by Stephen Sondheim
rows.hook: retells Romeo and Juliet with rival street gangs on the streets of New York

rows.label: Cats
rows.description: 1981 musical by Andrew Lloyd Webber
rows.hook: has a cast in whiskered costumes singing the ballad "Memory" at a junkyard gathering

rows.label: Fiddler on the Roof
rows.description: 1964 musical
rows.hook: follows a Jewish dairyman in a Russian village trying to marry off his five daughters

rows.label: Wicked
rows.description: 2003 musical based on the 1995 Gregory Maguire's novel
rows.hook: tells the untold story of two young witches who meet at school long before a girl from Kansas arrives in Oz

rows.label: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
rows.description: 1979 musical by Stephen Sondheim and Hugh Wheeler
rows.hook: follows a vengeful razor-wielding hairdresser and his pie-making partner in Victorian London

rows.label: Annie
rows.description: Broadway musical
rows.hook: follows a red-haired orphan who is taken in by a billionaire and sings about tomorrow

rows.label: The Sound of Music
rows.description: 1959 musical
rows.hook: follows a young governess who wins over a naval captain's seven children in the Alps

rows.label: Little Shop of Horrors
rows.description: 1982 horror comedy rock musical, by composer Alan Menken and writer Howard Ashman
rows.hook: features a man-eating plant with a booming voice that demands blood

rows.label: Into the Woods
rows.description: 1987 musical with music and lyrics by Stephen Sondheim and book by James Lapine
rows.hook: mixes fairy-tale characters like Cinderella and Jack with a baker and his wife on a quest

rows.label: Evita
rows.description: 1978 musical by Andrew Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice

rows.label: Hair
rows.description: 1967 rock musical; book and lyrics by Gerome Ragni and James Rado, music by Galt MacDermot

rows.label: Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat
rows.description: musical by Tim Rice and Andrew Lloyd Webber
rows.hook: retells the tale of a favored son with a many-colored coat who is sold by his jealous brothers

rows.label: Miss Saigon
rows.description: 1989 stage musical

rows.label: Guys and Dolls
rows.description: 1950 American musical with music and lyrics by Frank Loesser and book by Jo Swerling and Abe Burrows
rows.hook: follows Broadway gamblers, a nightclub singer and a mission-hall sergeant in a love-and-betting tale

rows.label: Oklahoma!
rows.description: 1943 musical; first musical written by the team of Rodgers and Hammerstein
rows.hook: set among farmers and cowboys in a frontier territory, opening with a song about a beautiful morning

rows.label: A Chorus Line
rows.description: musical by Marvin Hamlisch
rows.hook: shows dancers sweating through an audition for a place in a Broadway ensemble

rows.label: My Fair Lady
rows.description: 1956 musical based on Shaw's "Pygmalion"
rows.hook: has a flower girl taught to speak proper English by a stuffy phonetics professor

rows.label: Oliver!
rows.description: British musical, with music and lyrics by Lionel Bart
rows.hook: follows a workhouse orphan who famously dares to ask for more gruel

rows.label: South Pacific
rows.description: 1949 musical by Richard Rodgers, Oscar Hammerstein II, and Joshua Logan
rows.hook: tells of a Navy nurse and a French planter falling in love on a tropical island during World War II

rows.label: Billy Elliot the Musical
rows.description: musical based on the 2000 film Billy Elliot
rows.hook: follows a coal miner's son who trades boxing gloves for ballet shoes

rows.label: The Lion King
rows.description: 1997 stage musical with music by Elton John, lyrics by Tim Rice, and book by Roger Allers and Irene Mecchi based on the 1994 Disney animated film of the same name
rows.hook: features actors in giant animal puppets and masks telling of a cub exiled after his father's death

rows.label: The Producers
rows.description: 2001 musical written by Mel Brooks
rows.hook: follows two schemers who plan to get rich by staging a guaranteed flop

rows.label: The King and I
rows.description: 1951 musical by the team of composer Richard Rodgers and dramatist Oscar Hammerstein II
rows.hook: tells of a British schoolteacher hired to teach the many children of a Siamese monarch

rows.label: Hairspray
rows.description: American musical
rows.hook: follows a plus-size teen dancing her way onto a Baltimore TV dance show

rows.label: Hello, Dolly!
rows.description: musical
rows.hook: follows a matchmaker with a grand staircase entrance who sets her sights on a wealthy merchant

rows.label: Legally Blonde
rows.description: musical
rows.hook: follows a pink-loving sorority girl who gets into Harvard Law School to win back her ex

rows.label: Starlight Express
rows.description: 1984 British musical, with music by Andrew Lloyd Webber and lyrics by Richard Stilgoe
rows.hook: has performers on roller skates playing racing trains

rows.label: Anastasia
rows.description: 2016 musical
rows.hook: follows a young woman with amnesia who may be the lost daughter of Russia's last tsar
